Election Day Directives & Polling Information
Accreditation and voting proceed simultaneously from 8:30 AM to 2:30 PM on scheduled election days.

Day Directives & Polling Information
Accreditation and voting proceed simultaneously from 8:30 AM to 2:30 PM on scheduled election days. All voters must present their Permanent Voter Card (PVC) for verification via the Bimodal Voter Accreditation System (BVAS). Check Voter Status
